# API access

Expand even more

# **What is API access?**

By using the API access feature, you are able to share some easyPoints features.

# **Why should I use API?**

By using API Access, you can develop your own original system separate from the app's standard specifications.

# **What are the conditions for using the API?**

The API access feature is included in the enterprise plan or plans above that. If you are in the basic plan or the pro plan, you will need to pay an additional $50 per month to buy this feature separately.

# **API access settings**

For detailed usage instructions of the API, please refer to the easyPoints API specification document from the following link.
